root_cause: Existing canonical Janitor emits execution-only slowest job evidence but no bounded evidence-based owner routing. Separate agents may chase the same slow job, speculate on critical path, re-run CI without sufficient proof, or miss the highest actual execution-cost lane.

observed_evidence.observed_sample: 28 actual jobs, 13 workflow attempts, queue p95 3000 ms, slowest executed job 353000 ms, zero read errors, single-window observation not speedup
observed_evidence.phase_observation: Preflight 75s, mandatory static English/i18n complete-site cache operation around 47.47s, 132 files and 9101 strings; not a causal multi-run benchmark

fix: Project already verified diagnostic hotspots to a bounded one-owner-per-lane advisory list in the SAME hourly Janitor JSON artifact; cap to three lanes, retain source run/attempt/job/SHA and exact observed execution/wait, explicitly route unknown job names to unresolved owner, never fabricate a critical-path, speedup, provider check, authorization or merge. Block all recommendations if sample incomplete, provider errors, invalid identities, skipped/non-executed placeholders or duplicate job IDs. No automatic dispatch, issue creation, provider mutations or autonomous release from timing evidence.
prevention_rule: Use canonical incident/skills and one writer lease before coding, convert run evidence into owner-aware hypotheses only, compare exact SHA cold/warm outputs and protected CI before a reversible optimization. On insufficient evidence withhold rather than assign an invented owner. Never lower Required, CodeQL, Supabase, visual/CLS, RLS, tenant, finance or release gates. No second Janitor scheduler or external cost.

invariants: at least 20 executed jobs from five independent workflow attempts before an agent advice is emitted
partial provider reads or non-executed/duplicate job identities suppress all owner routing
only one bounded priority slot per domain owner; unknown owner remains unresolved
advice is read-only and may not dispatch CI, spend money, bypass gates or merge
existing Janitor schedule, canonical #4661 and Brain projection remain sole owner

terminal_rule: Only prove deployed after fresh exact-head Required+CodeQL, protected merge, main/Skill Projection readback and subsequent real Janitor artifact with agent_priority_advice. Full delivery-speed SLO remains open until longitudinal comparison.
